_why: Sweet Apple Acres dressing on Ponyville's north outskirts (dev 2026-09-23: moved closer, 'add fences and shit'). World XZ metres; heights come from the ground at runtime. Fence runs are open polylines; a gate is a gap between runs. The north-west corner stays open (2026-10-31): the painted road from town to the windmill crosses it at X 4..14 on the north side and Z -372..-391 on the west side.
